# pam

**pam** builds geographic presence-absence matrices (PAMs) from species
range polygons stored as
[`terra::SpatVector`](https://rspatial.github.io/terra/reference/SpatVector-class.html)
objects.

A PAM is a sites-by-species binary table: rows are grid cells, columns
are species, and each entry is `1` (present) or `0` (absent). PAMs are a
foundational data structure in macroecology and biogeography for
computing species richness, range-diversity plots, co-occurrence
analysis, and conservation prioritisation.

## Installation

``` r

# Install from GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("alrobles/PAM")
```

## Quick Start

``` r

library(pam)

# Load example data: Rodentia of Mexico
shp <- get_rodentia_mexico()

# Build PAM at 1-degree resolution
pam_result <- get_geo_pam(shp, res = 1)
head(pam_result)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 42
#>       x     y Chaetodipus arenarius ...
#>   <dbl> <dbl>                 <dbl>
#> 1 -118.  23.5                     0
#> ...
```

## Main Functions

| Function | Description |
|----|----|
| [`get_geo_pam()`](https://alrobles.github.io/pam/reference/get_geo_pam.md) | Build a PAM from a `SpatVector` at a given resolution |
| [`get_rodentia_mexico()`](https://alrobles.github.io/pam/reference/get_rodentia_mexico.md) | Example data: rodent ranges for Mexico |
| [`get_world_pca()`](https://alrobles.github.io/pam/reference/get_world_pca.md) | WorldClim bioclimatic PCA raster (2 layers) |

## Citation

If you use this package, please cite:

    Robles-Fernandez, A. L. (2023). pam: Presence-absence matrix from shapefiles.
    R package. doi:10.5281/zenodo.8189393

# Package index

## All functions

- [`get_geo_pam()`](https://alrobles.github.io/pam/reference/get_geo_pam.md)
  : Build a Presence-Absence Matrix from Species Range Polygons
- [`get_rodentia_mexico()`](https://alrobles.github.io/pam/reference/get_rodentia_mexico.md)
  : Retrieve Rodentia Range Maps for Mexico
- [`get_world_pca()`](https://alrobles.github.io/pam/reference/get_world_pca.md)
  : Retrieve a WorldClim PCA Environmental Raster
